title: Redis INFO output served in a response
description: The body is Redis INFO output: section headers such as # Server and # Clients followed by redis_version and connected_clients lines. It names the exact build, the memory ceiling and how many clients are attached, and it usually means the port is reachable from outside the application.
remediation: Bind Redis to the private interface, require authentication and an ACL, and never expose a diagnostics endpoint to the caller.
limitation: One response body. The check reads the INFO section shape; it does not connect to the instance or run a command.

observation.body:
# Server
redis_version:7.2.4
redis_mode:standalone
os:Linux 6.1 x86_64
# Clients
connected_clients:42
